researchNotes: Landsat 1 attitude-control description corrected to Freon using NASA Science; exact nozzle geometry remains uncertain.
ISS uses the 2011 main assembly configuration, not the current iROSA arrangement.
Galileo depicts the failed high-gain-antenna deployment; SLIM depicts the designed descent/landing pose, not its final inverted surface pose.
Starship uses the publicly described V3 configuration; dimensions and later revisions are version dependent.
New lessons and tools draw on NASA, Khronos, OpenCV, NAIF, MeshLab, ParaView, OCCT and CGAL primary documentation; the research workflow is this site's proposed method.
The two new NASA briefings distinguish publication date, event date and planned operations.
limitations: The collection remains a selection of 56 vehicles, not a complete global spaceflight catalog.
Finite geometry and framing checks do not certify dimensional or historical accuracy.
Models use normalized display coordinates and functional internal approximations. Section cuts are not capped solids; these meshes are not ready for mass-property, CFD or FEA calculations.
Browser checks cover representative interactions rather than every model and every state combination.
No original UE project code or assets were copied into this public website; project validation remains a record of the prior read-only review.
